text: State Highways in India are defined as stretches with heavy traffic intensity ranging from more than 10,000 to less than 30,000 Passenger Car Units (PCUs), connecting district headquarters, important towns, and both National Highways within the state and neighboring states. The Construction & Maintenance wing of the Highways Department is responsible for the construction and maintenance of all State Highways (SH), major district roads (MDR), and other district roads (ODR). The Tamil Nadu State Highways Network is divided into eight circles: Chennai, Villupuram, Madurai, Salem, Tiruchirappalli, Coimbatore, Tiruppur, and Tirunelveli. The state comprises a total of 286 state highways, 161 state highways urban (SH-U) stretches, and 905 major district roads (MDRs), in addition to other district roads (ODRs). This document provides a list of state highways in Tamil Nadu as of March 2019, and another list of state highways urban stretches in Tamil Nadu as of March 2019.
